module: Computation of the value and repair state of career vehicles and parts: depreciation per year of age (depreciationByYear table), loss related to mileage (odometer), scrap value (5% of the value), value of an inventory vehicle taking added/removed parts and damage into account, repair cost and duration (parts with integrity 0).
notes: Constants: loss of 0.0000025 per relative km, scrap 5%, 20 s of repair per part, threshold of 3 broken parts to consider the vehicle in need of repair, minimum value min(500, 5% of the new value).
The reference year is hardcoded to 2023 (age = 2023 - year) in getPartValue and getVehicleValue.
Repair price: 60% of part.value (700 by default) for each part whose integrityValue is 0.
In a vehicle's value, added parts count for 50% of their value and removed parts are subtracted at 50%.
partConditionsNeedRepair does not take exceptions into account (bumpers, doors, mirrors, front end): the old logic is commented out.

getVehicleMileageById.desc: Returns the mileage (odometer of the main part) of an inventory vehicle. 0 if not found.

returns.desc: Odometer (game unit for partCondition.odometer, inferred from code).

getAdjustedVehicleBaseValue.desc: Adjusted value of an item according to its age and mileage: yearly depreciation, mileage loss, plus the scrap value.

getPartDifference.desc: Compares a vehicle's original parts to the current parts and returns the added and removed parts per slot.

newParts.desc: Names of the current parts per slot.

changedSlots.desc: Modified slots (to detect an identical part being replaced).

getPartValue.desc: Value of a part: value adjusted by age and mileage, -5% if primered, reduced according to the number of repairs.

part.desc: Part with value, year, partCondition.odometer, primered, repairCount.

getRepairDetails.desc: Damage API: computes the price, duration and number of parts to replace for an inventory vehicle.

getInventoryVehicleValue.desc: Current value of an inventory vehicle (adjusted base + parts - repairs, floored at the minimum value).

ignoreDamage.desc: If true, does not deduct the repair cost.

returns.desc: Value, or nil if the vehicle does not exist.

getNumberOfBrokenParts.desc: Counts the parts whose integrityValue is 0.

returns.desc: Number of broken parts (0 if the argument is not a table).

partConditionsNeedRepair.desc: Indicates whether the number of broken parts reaches the threshold (3).

returns.desc: true if the vehicle needs repair.
